messages.subject: Circularity?
parts:
Hi everyone, 
I tried to test moderation and interaction effects (unsuccessfully) in a model (partially presented) of this type:

CAL~SEP+INT+IMPUTI 
INT~SEP
IMPUTI~SEP 

CAL~SEP (0.74***) + INT (n.s.) + IMPUTI (n.s.)
INT~SEP (0.64***)
IMPUTI~SEP (0.49***)

The results show a good model fit. According to theory, INT and IMPUTI should explain CAL. However, nothing significant appears in my results. Are there other ways in Lavaan to better understand the relationship between CAL and SEP/INT/IMPUTI? Thank you!
